title: Find the Interface

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: You got something to say, or you just wanna do a two-step on the sidewalk?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got something to say, or you just wanna do a two-step on the sidewalk?
Still walking and talking, sugarbean?
Saw the Carto-Carry, huh?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Crumbling faster than a Corpster's conscience at a charity auction. You got something to say, or just here to block the road?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crumbling faster than a Corpster's conscience at a charity auction. You got something to say, or just here to block the road?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Oh, I apologize, I always assume people know what I'm doing. This thing on my back is a Carto-Carry. Little piece of Curzona kit that allows me to map the streets of the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I apologize, I always assume people know what I'm doing. This thing on my back is a Carto-Carry. Little piece of Curzona kit that allows me to map the streets of the city.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: That's the million dollar question, isn't it? Data's never neutral. Best not to go there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the million dollar question, isn't it? Data's never neutral. Best not to go there.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Whatever you say, chief. Now, anything I can do? This data won't harvest itself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever you say, chief. Now, anything I can do? This data won't harvest itself.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Goes without saying. Now, anything I can do? This data won't harvest itself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goes without saying. Now, anything I can do? This data won't harvest itself.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Now why would you want one of those? They're useless now. Decommissioned. Deader than dancehall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now why would you want one of those? They're useless now. Decommissioned. Deader than dancehall.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Hey ya know... did see something once. Door in the Space Port marked with an Old Network symbol. Thought it might be some kind of dormant control room. I deleted it from the data.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey ya know... did see something once. Door in the Space Port marked with an Old Network symbol. Thought it might be some kind of dormant control room. I deleted it from the data.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: You hear stories about the Old Network. That it's... I dunno... The resting place of CORA or something. Dangerous, ya know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You hear stories about the Old Network. That it's... I dunno... The resting place of CORA or something. Dangerous, ya know?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Can't really remember the exact place... only the general area. And if you find it, don't tell anyone you got directions from me, OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't really remember the exact place... only the general area. And if you find it, don't tell anyone you got directions from me, OK?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Won't ask what you want it for, either. Data's trouble. Trust me I know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Won't ask what you want it for, either. Data's trouble. Trust me I know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm looking for information about Old Networks in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for information about Old Networks in Nivalis.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm looking for information about Old Networks in Nivalis.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm looking for information about Old Networks in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's the spine?
Is that a toy?
What for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever come across an Old Network interface in the LUZ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever come across an Old Network interface in the LUZ?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever come across an Old Network interface in the LUZ?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever come across an Old Network interface in the LUZ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never trust the corps.
Sure they've got good reasons.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever come across one of the old LifeCorp interfaces to the Old Network anywhere?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever come across one of the old LifeCorp interfaces to the Old Network anywhere?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever come across one of the old LifeCorp interfaces to the Old Network anywhere?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever come across one of the old LifeCorp interfaces to the Old Network anywhere?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All of them?
Why?
Where is it?
Of course.
So where is it?
What's that?
I need to find one.
